G1203.b:
⟪δεσπότης⟫, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨אָדוֹן⁩, ⁨אֲדֹנָי⁩; in Jth 9:17, δ. τ. οὐρανῶν κ. τ. γῆς]; ⟪a master, lord⟫, correlative of δοῦλος, οἰκέτης: ⟦1 Timothy 6:1|I Ti 6:1⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 6:2|2⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:21|II Ti 2:21⟧, ⟦Titus 2:9|Tit 2:9⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:18|I Pe 2:18⟧; as title of God, voc., δέσποτα (so usually in LXX), ⟦Luke 2:29|Lk 2:29⟧, ⟦Acts 4:24|Ac 4:24⟧; ὁ δ. = voc. δέσποτα (cf. B1., § 33, 4), ⟦Revelation 6:10|Re 6:10⟧; of Christ, ⟦2 Peter 2:1|II Pe 2:1⟧, ⟦Jude 1:4|Ju 4⟧, R, txt. (but cf. mg.).†
SYN.: κύριος (q.v.), implying limitation of authority and a more general relation than δ., which "denoted absolute ownership and uncontrolled power" (Thayer).

G1205.b:
⟪δεῦτε⟫ adv., as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), q.v.,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨לְכוּ⁩ ;] ⟪come on! come here! come!⟫: c. imperat., ⟦Matthew 25:34|Mt 25:34⟧ ⟦Matthew 28:6|28:6⟧, ⟦John 4:29|Jo 4:29⟧ ⟦John 21:12|21:12⟧, ⟦Revelation 19:17|Re 19:17⟧; c. subjc., ⟦Matthew 21:38|Mt 21:38⟧, ⟦Mark 12:7|Mk 12:7⟧; seq. ὀπίσω, ⟦Matthew 4:19|Mt 4:19⟧, ⟦Mark 1:17|Mk 1:17⟧; πρός, ⟦Matthew 11:28|Mt 11:28⟧; εἰς, ⟦Matthew 22:4|Mt 22:4⟧, ⟦Mark 6:31|Mk 6:31⟧.†

G1206.b:
* ⟪δευτεραῖος⟫, -α, -ον
(< δεύτερος), adj. with adverbial sense; ⟪on the second day⟫: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, ⟦Acts 28:13|Ac 28:13⟧.†

G1207.b: *† ⟪δευτερό-πρωτος⟫, -ον ⟪second-first⟫ (in what sense, there is no satisfactory explanation. The reading is prob. not original, v. ICC, in l.; DCG, i, 411; ii, 541, 724): ⟦Luke 6:1|Lk 6:1⟧, WH, mg., R, mg.†

G1208.b: ⟪δεῦτερος⟫, -α, -ον, ⟪second⟫ in order, with or without idea of time: ⟦Matthew 22:26|Mt 22:26⟧, ⟦Matthew 22:39|39⟧, al.; θάνατος, ⟦Revelation 2:11|Re 2:11⟧ ⟦Revelation 20:14|20:14⟧ ⟦Revelation 21:8|21:8⟧; χάρις, ⟦2 Corinthians 1:15|II Co 1:15⟧. In neut. as adv., ⟪secondly, a second time⟫; opp. to πρῶτον: ⟦John 3:4|Jo 3:4⟧ ⟦John 21:16|21:16⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 12:28|I Co 12:28⟧, ⟦Revelation 19:3|Re 19:3⟧; τὸ δ., ⟦2 Corinthians 13:2|II Co 13:2⟧, ⟦Jude 1:5|Ju 5⟧; ἐν τ. δ., ⟪at the second time⟫: ⟦Acts 7:13|Ac 7:13⟧; in later usage (as I Mac 9:1), ἐκ δ., ⟦Mark 14:72|Mk 14:72⟧, ⟦John 9:24|Jo 9:24⟧, ⟦Acts 11:9|Ac 11:9⟧, ⟦Hebrews 9:28|He 9:28⟧.

G1209.b:

⟪1.⟫ c. acc rei, of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, ⟦Luke 16:6|Lk 16:6⟧, ⟦Luke 16:7|7⟧; id. in different sense, ⟦Acts 28:21|Ac 28:21⟧; ποτήριον, ⟦Luke 22:17|Lk 22:17⟧; παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), ⟦Luke 2:28|Lk 2:28⟧; περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, ⟦Ephesians 6:17|Eph 6:17⟧; ἐπιστολάς, ⟦Acts 22:5|Ac 22:5⟧; τ. βασιλείαν τ. ⟪2.⟫ C. acc pers., of receiving kindly or hospitably, ⟦Matthew 10:14|Mt 10:14⟧, ⟦Matthew 10:40|40⟧, ⟦Matthew 10:41|41⟧, ⟦Mark 6:11|Mk 6:11⟧, ⟦Luke 9:5|Lk 9:5⟧, ⟦Luke 9:53|53⟧ ⟦Luke 10:8|10:8⟧, ⟦Luke 10:10|10⟧, ⟦John 4:45|Jo 4:45⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 7:15|II Co 7:15⟧ ⟦2 Corinthians 11:16|11:16⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:14|Ga 4:14⟧, ⟦Colossians 4:10|Col 4:10⟧, ⟦Hebrews 11:31|He 11:31⟧; παιδίον, ⟦Matthew 18:5|Mt 18:5⟧, ⟦Mark 9:37|Mk 9:37⟧, ⟦Luke 9:48|Lk 9:48⟧; εἰς οἴκους, σκηνάς, ⟦Luke 16:4|Lk 16:4⟧, ⟦Luke 16:9|9⟧; δέξαι τ. πνεῦμά μου, ⟦Acts 7:59|Ac 7:59⟧; ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν δέασθαι, ⟦Acts 3:21|Ac 3:21⟧ (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο, δια-, εἰσ-, ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, προσ-, ὑπο-δέχομαι; Cremer, 174).†

G1210.b:
⟪δέω⟫ (I),
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨אסר⁩ ;] ⟪to tie, bind, fasten⟫;
⟪(1)⟫ c. acc. rei, seq. εἰς δεσμάς, ⟦Matthew 13:30|Mt 13:30⟧; of an ass, ⟦Matthew 21:2|Mt 21:2⟧, ⟦Mark 11:2|Mk 11:2⟧, ⟦Mark 11:4|4⟧ ⟦Luke 19:30|Lk 19:30⟧.
⟪(2)⟫ c. acc. pers., of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, ⟦John 19:40|Jo 19:40⟧; δεδομένος τ. πόδας . . . κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), ⟦John 11:44|Jo 11:44⟧; of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, ⟦Revelation 9:14|Re 9:14⟧; a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, ⟦Mark 5:3|Mk 5:3⟧, ⟦Mark 5:4|4⟧; captives, ⟦Matthew 12:29|Mt 12:29⟧ ⟦Matthew 14:3|14:3⟧ ⟦Matthew 22:13|22:13⟧ ⟦Matthew 27:2|27:2⟧, ⟦Mark 3:27|Mk 3:27⟧ ⟦Mark 6:17|6:17⟧ ⟦Mark 15:1|15:1⟧, ⟦Mark 15:7|7⟧, ⟦John 18:12|Jo 18:12⟧, ⟦John 18:24|24⟧, ⟦Acts 9:2|Ac 9:2⟧, ⟦Acts 9:14|14⟧, ⟦Acts 9:21|21⟧, ⟦Acts 21:11|21:11⟧, ⟦Acts 21:13|13⟧ ⟦Acts 22:5|22:5⟧, ⟦Acts 22:29|29⟧ ⟦Acts 24:27|24:27⟧, ⟦Colossians 4:3|Col 4:3⟧, ⟦Revelation 20:2|Re 20:2⟧; ἁλύσεσι, ⟦Acts 12:6|Ac 12:6⟧ ⟦Acts 21:33|21:33⟧. Metaph., ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ, ⟦2 Timothy 2:9|II Ti 2:9⟧; of Satan binding by disease (MM, s.v.), ⟦Luke 13:16|Lk 13:16⟧; of constraint or obligation, ⟦Acts 20:22|Ac 20:22⟧; of the marriage bond, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:39|I Co 7:39⟧; id. c. dat. pers., ἀνδρί, ⟦Romans 7:2|Ro 7:2⟧; γυναικί, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:27|I Co 7:27⟧; in Rabbinic lang. (Dalman, Words, 213f.), ⟪to forbid, declare forbidden⟫, ⟦Matthew 16:19|Mt 16:19⟧ ⟦Matthew 18:18|18:18⟧ (cf. κατα-, περι-, συν-, ὐπο-δέω; Cremer, 82).†

G1211.b:
⟪δή⟫ consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as ⟪now therefore, then, verily, certainly⟫.
⟪1.⟫ With verbs: imperat., ⟦Acts 6:3|Ac 6:3⟧ (WH, mg.) ⟦Acts 13:2|13:2⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 6:20|I Co 6:20⟧; hort. subjc., ⟦Luke 2:15|Lk 2:15⟧, ⟦Acts 15:36|Ac 15:36⟧; indic., δή που (T, δήπου, q.v.), ⟦Hebrews 2:16|He 2:16⟧.
⟪2.⟫ With pronouns: ὃ δή, ⟪now this is he who⟫, ⟦Matthew 13:23|Mt 13:23⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G1212.b:
⟪δῆλος⟫, -η, -ον
[in LXX for ⁨אוּר⁩, etc. ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪visible⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪clear⟫ to the mind, ⟪evident⟫: ⟦Matthew 26:73|Mt 26:73⟧; δ. (sc. ἐστίν), seq. ὅτι, ⟦1 Corinthians 15:27|I Co 15:27⟧, ⟦Galatians 3:11|Ga 3:11⟧.†
SYN.: φανερός, with ref. to outward appearance, ⟪manifest⟫ as opp. to concealed; δ. with ref. to inner perception, ⟪evident⟫, known, under­stood.

G1213.b:
⟪δηλόω⟫, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨ידע⁩ ;] ⟪to make plain, declare⟫: c. acc., ⟦1 Corinthians 3:13|I Co 3:13⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:8|Col 1:8⟧, ⟦Hebrews 9:8|He 9:8⟧ ⟦Hebrews 12:27|12:27⟧; c. dat. pers., ⟦2 Peter 1:14|II Pe 1:14⟧; c. dat. pers., seq. περί (pass.), ⟦1 Corinthians 1:11|I Co 1:11⟧; seq. εἰς, ⟦1 Peter 1:11|I Pe 1:11⟧.†
SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, ⟪to make manifest⟫, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind.

G1214.b:
⟪Δημᾶς⟫, ὁ

G1215.b:
⟪δημηγορέω⟫, -ῶ

G1217.b:
** ⟪δημιουργός⟫, -οῦ, ὑ
(< δῆμος, ἔργον), [in LXX: II Mac 4:1 * ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪one who works for the people⟫.
⟪2.⟫ Univ., ⟪an author, builder, maker⟫; ⟪the maker⟫ of the world (Xen., Mem., I, 4, 9, al.), ⟦Hebrews 11:10|He 11:10⟧.†
SYN.: κτίστης, ⟪creator⟫, τεχνίτης, ⟪craftsman, designer⟫. In ⟦Hebrews 11:10|He, l.c.⟧, τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution.

G1218.b:
⟪δῆμος⟫, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨מִשְׁפָּחָה⁩ ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a district⟫, ⟪country⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪the common people⟫, ⟪the people⟫ generally; esp. ⟪the people assembled⟫: ⟦Acts 12:22|Ac 12:22⟧ ⟦Acts 17:5|17:5⟧ ⟦Acts 19:30|19:30⟧, ⟦Acts 19:33|33⟧.†
SYN.: λαός, ⟪the people⟫ at large: δ., the people as a body politic; opp. to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized ⟪multitude⟫. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, ⟪a nation⟫, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: ⟪Gentiles⟫. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is freq. in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. Cl. Rev., i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689).
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

[in LXX for ⁨אבה⁩, ⁨חבל⁩, etc. ;] ⟪to part asunder, dissolve⟫; of an assembly, pass., ⟪to disperse⟫: ⟦Acts 5:36|Ac 5:36⟧.†

G1263.b:
⟪δια-μαρτύρομαι⟫, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, q.v.,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨עוּד⁩ hi., usually c. dat. pers., ⟦Deuteronomy 4:26|De 4:26⟧ ⟦Deuteronomy 8:19|8:19⟧, ⟦1 Samuel 8:9|I Ki 8:9⟧, al. ;] ⟪solemnly to protest⟫: ⟦Luke 16:28|Lk 16:28⟧, ⟦Acts 2:40|Ac 2:40⟧ ⟦Acts 8:25|8:25⟧ ⟦Acts 10:42|10:42⟧ ⟦Acts 18:5|18:5⟧ ⟦Acts 20:21|20:21⟧, ⟦Acts 20:23|23⟧, ⟦Acts 20:24|24⟧ ⟦Acts 23:11|23:11⟧ ⟦Acts 28:23|28:23⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 4:6|I Th 4:6⟧, ⟦Hebrews 2:6|He 2:6⟧; in adjuration, seq. ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, ⟦1 Timothy 5:21|I Ti 5:21⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 2:14|II Ti 2:14⟧ ⟦2 Timothy 4:1|4:1⟧ (Cremer, 415).†
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G1264.b:
⟪δια-μάχομαι⟫
[in LXX for ⁨לחם⁩ ni., ⟦Daniel 10:20|Da LXX 10:20⟧; Si 8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 * ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to struggle against⟫.
⟪2.⟫ In argument, ⟪to contend⟫: ⟦Acts 23:9|Ac 23:9⟧.†

G1265.b:
⟪δια-μένω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨עמד⁩, etc.;] ⟪to remain, continue⟫: ⟦Luke 1:22|Lk 1:22⟧ ⟦Luke 22:28|22:28⟧, ⟦Galatians 2:5|Ga 2:5⟧, ⟦Hebrews 1:11|He 1:11⟧ (LXX), ⟦2 Peter 3:4|II Pe 3:4⟧.†

G1266.b:
⟪δια-μερίζω⟫
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨חלק⁩ pi. ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to distribute⟫: c. dat. pers., ⟦Acts 2:45|Ac 2:45⟧; seq. εἰς, ⟦Luke 22:17|Lk 22:17⟧, pass., ⟦Acts 2:3|Ac 2:3⟧. Mid. ⟪to distribute among themselves⟫: ⟦Matthew 27:35|Mt 27:35⟧, ⟦Mark 15:24|Mk 15:24⟧, ⟦Luke 23:34|Lk 23:34⟧; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, ⟦John 19:24|Jo 19:24⟧ (LXX) (v. M, Pr., 157).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to divide, separate⟫: pass., seq. ἐπί, c. acc., ⟦Luke 11:17|Lk 11:17⟧, ⟦Luke 11:18|18⟧; ἐπί, c. dat., ⟦Luke 12:52|Lk 12:52⟧, ⟦Luke 12:53|53⟧.†
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G1267.b:
⟪δια-μερισμός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(< διαμερίζω), [in LXX: ⟦Ezekiel 48:29|Ez 48:29⟧ (⁨מַחֲלֹקֶת⁩), ⟦Micah 7:12|Mi 7:12⟧ * ;] ⟪a division⟫: opp. to εἰρήνη, ⟦Luke 12:51|Lk 12:51⟧.†

G1268.b:
⟪δια-νέμω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨חלק⁩, ⟦Deuteronomy 29:25|De 29:26(25)⟧ * ;] ⟪to distribute, divide⟫: pass., ⟪to be spread about⟫, ⟦Acts 4:17|Ac 4:17⟧.†

G1269.b:
† ⟪δια-νεύω⟫
[in LXX: ⟦Psalms 35:19|Ps 34(35):19⟧ (⁨קרץ⁩), Si 27:22 * ;] ⟪to wink at, nod to, beckon to⟫: ⟦Luke 1:22|Lk 1:22⟧.†

G1270.b:
⟪δια-νόημα⟫, -τος, τό
(< διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for ⁨מַחֲשָׁבָה⁩, etc., ⟦Isaiah 55:9|Is 55:9⟧, al., freq. in Si ;] ⟪a thought⟫: ⟦Luke 11:17|Lk 11:17⟧.†

G1271.b:
⟪διάνοια⟫, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨לֵב⁩, ⁨לֵבָב⁩ ;] ⟪the understanding, mind⟫: ⟦Luke 1:51|Lk 1:51⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:18|Eph 4:18⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:21|Col 1:21⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:13|I Pe 1:13⟧, ⟦2 Peter 3:1|II Pe 3:1⟧, ⟦1 John 5:20|I Jo 5:20⟧; pl., ⟦Ephesians 2:3|Eph 2:3⟧; in quotations from LXX, ⟦Matthew 22:37|Mt 22:37⟧, ⟦Mark 12:30|Mk 12:30⟧, ⟦Luke 10:27|Lk 10:27⟧, ⟦Hebrews 8:10|He 8:10⟧ ⟦Hebrews 10:16|10:16⟧ (Cremer, 79, 438).†
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G1272.b:
⟪δι-αν-οίγω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨פּטר⁩ (Ex, Nu), ⁨פּקח⁩, ⁨פּתח⁩, etc. ;] ⟪to open up completely, to open⟫: ⟦Luke 2:23|Lk 2:23⟧ (LXX); pass., ⟦Mark 7:34|Mk 7:34⟧, ⟦Acts 7:56|Ac 7:56⟧. Metaph., δ. τ. νοῦν, ⟦Luke 24:45|Lk 24:45⟧, τ. καρδίαν, ⟦Acts 16:14|Ac 16:14⟧, pass., οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, ⟦Luke 24:31|Lk 24:31⟧; of explaining, τ. γραφάς, ⟦Luke 24:32|Lk 24:32⟧, ⟦Acts 17:3|Ac 17:3⟧.†

G1273.b:
⟪δια-νυκτερεύω⟫
(cf. διημερεύω, ⟪to pass the day⟫) [in LXX: ⟦Job 2:9|Jb 2:9⟧ * ;] ⟪to pass the night⟫: seq. ἐν τ. προσευχῆ, ⟦Luke 6:12|Lk 6:12⟧.†

G1274.b:
** ⟪δι-ανύω⟫
[in LXX: II Mac 12:17 * ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to accomplish fully, finish, complete⟫: ⟦Acts 21:7|Ac 21:7⟧ (EV).
⟪2.⟫ In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), ⟪to continue⟫: Ac, l.c. (Field, Notes, 134 f.).†
a: Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G1276.b:
⟪δια-περάω⟫, -ῶ
[in LXX: ⟦Deuteronomy 30:13|De 30:13⟧, ⟦Isaiah 23:2|Is 23:2⟧ (⁨עבר⁩), I Mac 6 * ;] ⟪to pass over, cross over⟫: ⟦Matthew 9:1|Mt 9:1⟧; seq. ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, ⟦Matthew 14:34|Mt 14:34⟧, ⟦Mark 6:53|Mk 6:53⟧; εἰς, ⟦Mark 5:21|Mk 5:21⟧, ⟦Acts 21:2|Ac 21:2⟧; πρὸς ἡμᾶς, ⟦Luke 16:26|Lk 16:26⟧.†

G1278.b:
⟪δια-πονέω⟫, -ῶ
[in LXX: ⟦Ecclesiastes 10:9|Ec 10:9⟧ (⁨עצב⁩ ni.), II Mac 2:28; in Aq.: ⟦Genesis 6:6|Ge 6:6⟧, ⟦1 Samuel 20:3|I Ki 20:3⟧ * ;] ⟪to work out with labour⟫. Pass., ⟪to be worn out, sore troubled⟫: ⟦Mark 14:4|Mk 14:4⟧ (WH, mg.), ⟦Acts 4:2|Ac 4:2⟧ ⟦Acts 16:18|16:18⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G1279.b:
⟪δια-πορεύω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨עבר⁩, ⁨הלךְ⁩, etc. ;] ⟪to carry over⟫. Pass., ⟪to pass across, journey through⟫: absol., ⟦Luke 18:36|Lk 18:36⟧, ⟦Romans 15:24|Ro 15:24⟧; seq. κατὰ πόλεις κ. κώμας, ⟦Luke 13:22|Lk 13:22⟧; διά, c. gen., ⟦Mark 2:23|Mk 2:23⟧, ⟦Luke 6:1|Lk 6:1⟧ (cf. ⟦Proverbs 9:12|Pr 9:12⟧ c, Wi 3:1); c. acc, ⟦Acts 16:4|Ac 16:4⟧.†

G1280.b:

[in Sm.: ⟦Psalms 77:5|Ps 76(77):5⟧, ⟦Daniel 2:1|Da 2:1⟧ * ;] ⟪to be quite at a loss, be in great perplexity⟫: absol., ⟦Acts 2:12|Ac 2:12⟧; seq. διὰ τό, c. inf., ⟦Luke 9:7|Lk 9:7⟧; περί, ⟦Acts 5:24|Ac 5:24⟧; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, ⟦Acts 10:17|Ac 10:17⟧.†

a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G1282.b:
⟪δια-πρίω⟫
[in LXX: ⟦1 Chronicles 20:3|I Ch 20:3⟧ (⁨שׂוּר⁩) * ;] ⟪to saw asunder⟫. Pass., metaph. (vernacular?), EV, ⟪cut to the heart⟫: ⟦Acts 5:33|Ac 5:33⟧; seq. τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, ⟦Acts 7:54|Ac 7:54⟧.†

G1284.b:
⟪δια-ρήσσω⟫ (so WH, exc. Ac, l.c.), δια-ρρήσσω
(poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨קרע⁩ ;] ⟪to break asunder⟫, ⟪burst⟫, ⟪rend⟫: δεσμά, ⟦Luke 8:29|Lk 8:29⟧; pass., δίκτυα, ⟦Luke 5:6|Lk 5:6⟧; ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger (as ⟦Genesis 37:29|Ge 37:29⟧, al.), ⟦Matthew 26:65|Mt 26:65⟧, ⟦Acts 14:14|Ac 14:14⟧, ⟦Mark 14:63|Mk 14:63⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G1285.b:
⟪δια-σαφέω⟫, -ῶ
(< σαφής, clear), [in LXX: ⟦Deuteronomy 1:5|De 1:5⟧ (⁨בּאר⁩ pi.), ⟦Daniel 2:6|Da LXX, 2:6⟧ (⁨חוה⁩ aph.), I-III Ma 9 * ;] ⟪to make clear, explain fully⟫: c. acc. rei, dat. pers., ⟦Matthew 13:26|Mt 13:26⟧ ⟦Matthew 18:31|18:31⟧.†

G1286.b:

[in LXX: ⟦Job 4:14|Jb 4:14⟧ (⁨פּחד⁩ hi.), III Mac 7:21 * ;] ⟪to shake violently⟫; metaph., ⟪to intimidate⟫: ⟦Luke 3:14|Lk 3:14⟧.†

G1287.b:
† ⟪δια-σκορπίζω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨פּוּץ⁩, ⁨זרה⁩, etc. ;] ⟪to scatter abroad, disperse⟫: of sheep, ⟦Matthew 26:31|Mt 26:31⟧ = ⟦Mark 14:27|Mk 14:27⟧ (LXX); of persons, ⟦Luke 1:51|Lk 1:51⟧, ⟦Acts 5:37|Ac 5:37⟧, opp. to συνάγω, ⟦John 11:52|Jo 11:52⟧; of winnowing grain, ⟦Matthew 25:24|Mt 25:24⟧, ⟦Matthew 25:26|26⟧; metaph., of property, ⟪to squander, waste⟫: ⟦Luke 15:13|Lk 15:13⟧ ⟦Luke 16:1|16:1⟧.†

G1288.b:
⟪δια-σπάω⟫, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨נתק⁩, as ⟦Judges 16:9|Jg 16:9⟧ ;] ⟪to break⟫ or ⟪tear asunder⟫: pass., ἁλύσεις, ⟦Mark 5:4|Mk 5:4⟧; Παῦλος, ⟦Acts 23:10|Ac 23:10⟧.†

G1289.b:
⟪δια-σπείρω⟫
[freq. in LXX for ⁨פּוּץ⁩, etc. ;] ⟪to scatter abroad, disperse⟫: ⟦Acts 8:1|Ac 8:1⟧, ⟦Acts 8:4|4⟧ ⟦Acts 11:19|11:19⟧.†

G1290.b:

(< διασπείρω), [in LXX of Israelites dispersed and exiled in foreign lands, as ⟦Deuteronomy 28:25|De 28:25⟧ (⁨זַעֲוָה⁩) ⟦Deuteronomy 30:4|30:4⟧ (⁨נדח⁩ ni.), ⟦Isaiah 49:6|Is 49:6⟧ (⁨נער⁩); by meton., of the exiles themselves (as ⟦Psalms 147:2|Ps 146 (147):2⟧, II Mac 1:27) ;] ⟪a dispersion⟫: δ. τῶν Ἑλλήνων, ⟦John 7:35|Jo 7:35⟧; metaph., of Christians (DB, iii, 782 f.), ⟦James 1:1|Ja 1:1⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:1|I Pe 1:1⟧ (v. Hort, in ll.).†

G1291.b:
⟪δια-στέλλω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨בּדל⁩ hi. (⟦Deuteronomy 10:8|De 10:8⟧, al.), ⁨זהר⁩ hi. (⟦Ezekiel 3:18|Ez 3:18⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 3:19|19⟧, al.), and 19 other words]

⟪2.⟫ ⟪to command, charge expressly⟫: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, ⟦Hebrews 12:20|He 12:20⟧. Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.c.; et al. in LXX; MM, s.v.); a. dat. pers., ⟦Mark 8:15|Mk 8:15⟧, ⟦Acts 15:24|Ac 15:24⟧; seq. ἵνα, ⟦Matthew 16:20|Mt 16:20⟧, ⟦Mark 5:43|Mk 5:43⟧ ⟦Mark 7:36|7:36⟧ ⟦Mark 9:9|9:9⟧.†

G1292.b:
⟪διάστημα⟫, -τος, τό
(< διίστημι), [in LXX for ⁨רֶוַח⁩, etc.;] ⟪an interval, space⟫: of time (Si, prol.24), ⟦Acts 5:7|Ac 5:7⟧.†

G1293.b:
⟪δια-στολή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ
(< διαστέλλω), [in LXX for ⁨פְּדוּת⁩: ⟦Exodus 8:23|Ex 8:23(19)⟧, etc. ;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a separation⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a distinction, difference⟫: ⟦Romans 3:22|Ro 3:22⟧ ⟦Romans 10:12|10:12⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 14:7|I Co 14:7⟧.†

G1294.b:
⟪δια-στρέφω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨הפךְ⁩, ⁨עקשׁ⁩, etc. ;] ⟪to distort, twist⟫; metaph., ⟪to distort, pervert⟫: ⟦Luke 23:2|Lk 23:2⟧, ⟦Acts 13:8|Ac 13:8⟧, ⟦Acts 13:10|10⟧; διεστραμμένος, ⟪perverse⟫: ⟦Matthew 17:17|Mt 17:17⟧, ⟦Luke 9:41|Lk 9:41⟧, ⟦Acts 20:30|Ac 20:30⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:15|Phl 2:15⟧.†

G1295.b:
⟪δια-σώζω⟫
[in LXX for ⁨מלט⁩, ⁨ישׁע⁩, etc. ;] ⟪to bring safely through⟫ a danger: ⟦Luke 7:3|Lk 7:3⟧, ⟦Acts 27:43|Ac 27:43⟧; seq. πρός, ⟦Acts 23:24|Ac 23:24⟧.
